notes.title: SLINGSHOT PROCOTOL demo has been released
notes.content:
Hi, I am the solo developer of SLINGSHOT PROTOCOL. After three years of work in my spare time I am finally able to share a demo on steam.

This demo is designed to generate possible interest in the game and to gather feedback. 

I will be monitoring this for the upcoming month of august. This is the first release of my game outside of small testing. Please report any issues that you may have, it would be of great help to me to assure a good gaming experience. I will plan a first patch mid September based on this, for any problems that might be found.

If you wish to follow the development of SLINGSHOT PROTOCOL. I will upload monthly development showcases on my YouTube channel.
